verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about a live event debugger, per-destination delivery metrics or error views, or alerting on delivery failures. The 'View and enforce your data quality' and 'Ensure data quality' items are bare titles about data quality, which is an adjacent area, not pipeline observability. The axis clearly applies to a customer data platform that forwards data to destinations, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting
